name: data360-mcp-monorepo
description: Workspace root for @data360 npm packages (tool-types, mcp-viz-core, mcp-ui, mcp-ui-angular).

scripts.rebuild:viz-stack: npm run clean && npm run build:viz-stack
scripts.build:viz-stack: npm run build -w @data360/tool-types && npm run build -w @data360/chart-payload-normalize && npm run build -w @data360/mcp-viz-core && npm run build -w @data360/mcp-ui
